about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover TDV6 and SDV6 are 3.0-litre V6 diesel engines fitted across the L322 and L405 generations from 2001 to 2021. The TDV6 and SDV6 are part of the same engine family — the SDV6 is essentially a higher-output version of the TDV6, sharing the same fundamental architecture and components, including the well-documented timing chain and injector wear pattern. The current L460-generation Range Rover moved to the Ingenium I6 diesel family, which is a different engine design. Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 Engine Codes TDV6 / SDV6 (L322, L405) A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Range Rover from 2001 to 2021, across two generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal failure — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 and SDV6 rebuild. Check Your TDV6/SDV6 Range Rover → [link to quote form] Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 Engine Compatibility Because the Range Rover TDV6 and SDV6 share the same engine family across both the L322 and L405 generations, the rebuild process and components are consistent. However, the exact specification can vary between years. The Range Rover TDV6 and SDV6 use a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, fitted across the L322 and L405 generations from 2001 to 2021. The SDV6 is a higher-output version of the same engine family. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover TDV6 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,400, for either the TDV6 or SDV6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV6 or the SDV6 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV6 Range Rover engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, turbo and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild. Do you rebuild SDV6 Range Rover engines? Yes. The SDV6 shares the same engine family as the TDV6, and we service it to the same standard with the same components replaced. Do you supply used Range Rover TDV6 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover TDV6 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover TDV6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover TDV6 from 2023 to present. The TDV6 or SDV6 (M57D30) features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV6 or SDV6 (M57D30) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 or SDV6 (M57D30) rebuild.
